# proxmox_users (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all Proxmox VE users from `/access/users`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_users" "all" {}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `users` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `expire` (Number)
- `firstname` (String)
- `groups` (String)
- `lastname` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
